Independent Gemini advisory review executed over the full canonical TASK-047 plan (78 KB) and current MB3 state. Scope: TASK-047 / UR-002 / IMPLEMENT / Plan Fidelity. Advisory only; no gate clearance. Gemini assessed UR-002 design coverage as present in plan but implementation evidence absent: implementation artifact remains empty template, workspace has no product-code changes, and IMPLEMENT gate remains open. Advisory verdict REVISE/HOLD because there is no implementation to assess. Findings: (1) IMPLEMENT cannot close before planned implementation WUs and evidence exist; this is current status/blocker, not a code defect. (2) HIGH risk in W8 streaming EpubBlockFramer parity with Marked on lazy lists, blockquotes, multiline HTML and deferred reference definitions; require strict full-AST differential oracle, fail closed on mismatch. This concern is already addressed in plan §5.2 by differential AST parity and E_PARSE on unconsumed suffix, but must remain an implementation acceptance gate. (3) MEDIUM risk of layout sizing iteration due chapter filename/link-length changes. Plan §3.4 already requires monotonic added cuts, E_LAYOUT_STALLED on no progress, and termination within cutCount+1; reviewer proposal for headroom/iteration cap is substantively covered, no change needed absent a concrete counterexample. (4) MEDIUM T4 qaLevel=STANDARD mismatch; plan §1 and §9 already flag for runtime reconciliation before implementation. Gemini reports no phase transition and no authoritative MB3 verdict. Preserve verdict as advisory only; authoritative IMPLEMENT gate is open.
